description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of language family on the performance of multilingual BERT models, with the vertical axis representing the effect (ranging from 0 to 40) and the horizontal axis showing different language families (IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic). Each language family has four bars, corresponding to different model configurations: mBERT-targ (light blue), XLM-targ (dark blue), mBERT-permute (light green), and XLM-permute (dark green), as indicated by the legend. The height of each bar reflects the magnitude of the effect, with error bars indicating the standard deviation. For instance, in the IE-Baltic category, mBERT-targ has an effect of approximately 22, XLM-targ around 16, mBERT-permute about 7, and XLM-permute around 6. In the Uralic category, mBERT-targ shows the highest effect at approximately 30, followed by XLM-targ at about 22, mBERT-permute at around 1, and XLM-permute at approximately 1. The chart reveals variability in effects across language families and model configurations, with some families like Isolate showing a large effect for mBERT-targ (around 35) and XLM-targ (around 25), while mBERT-permute and XLM-permute have very low effects (around 2 and 2, respectively).
